title: Kelsey Civic Center’s permit closed a year after the City’s forecast

beats.text: The City forecast an October 2024 finish for a housing project at Civic Center.

visual.sub: October 2024 forecast and April 2025 reported completion

beats.text: The design competition started with ten teams. Four reached round two.
In 2019 the team was selected, before the housing office joined the project.
The preliminary City financing figure was thirteen million dollars.

visual.label: The permanent City loan and the separate bridge

beats.text: The final request separated permanent financing from a one million dollar bridge.
The construction estimate had risen by about eight million dollars.

visual.label: The permanent City loan and the separate bridge

beats.text: Two later City financing commitments add to the earlier permanent request.
In February 2025 crews were still finishing common areas.

visual.kicker: October 2024 forecast and April 2025 reported completion

beats.text: The City financing report lists April 9 as completion, about six months after the forecast.

visual.kicker: October 2024 forecast and April 2025 reported completion

beats.text: By July, the sponsor reported residents moving in.
The main building permit closed on October 31, a year after the forecast month.
The permit counted 112 apartments. The City listed 110 income-restricted homes.
The original budget included two units for resident managers.

visual.kicker: Two staff units explain the published unit counts

beats.text: The record does not establish the first occupancy date or who caused the delay.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
